text_block_list.text: As summer training camp reached its peak—

Today, Marvelous Sunday was busy since 
morning with joint training alongside 
Mayano Top Gun and Sakura Laurel.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah☆ Found the star of the beach~★ Look, 
look, everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Brian! You're working super hard today 
too, aren't you☆

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...AAAAAAAHHH!!

Narita Brian drew immense attention with 
the announcement of her summer return. 
Everyone is buzzing with excitement, 
anticipating the comeback of the strongest 
Umamusume—and yet...

They had their eyes on Narita Brian more 
than anyone else and seemed hyper-aware of 
her presence, but their expressions 
were... tense.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "...Hey. Hey, Laurel-san, Maya—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "You figured it out"?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I feel the same as you, 
Maya-chan. I think... we're thinking the 
exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
? Oh my, what's the matter with you two? I 
sense a very novelous vibe...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...It's about Brian-chan, you see.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
To me, and to Maya-chan as well, 
Brian-chan is a goal to strive for. Like a 
guiding beacon, in a way.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
She is always right there, wherever I 
look. ...But that's why—maybe that's why I 
could see it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Brian-chan's running... it's changed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's no longer the run of the 
"strongest"... that everyone dreamed of 
and yearned for.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to struggle all through the 
summer to run like she used to. But—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It hasn't returned. ...Maybe... it never 
will.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Hey, do you really think so? Maybe 
Maya's "I get it" was a lie this time!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I wish that were true too, but... 
.........

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I seeee~... So both Mayano and Laurel came 
to that realization, huh.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Then that makes it Marvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! Mave-chin, what are you saying?! 
It's totally nothing like that...!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Because, even though Brian-san ended up 
like that! This isn't marvelous at all—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Still, Mayano and Laurel "realized that"! 
Right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Uh, well... I mean, that's true, but—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"‘Noticing’ is an amazing thing!! Because 
you can reach out to pain that might have 
been buried. You can be there for them!!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Brian has always been a shining light to 
you and Laurel? Then this time, the two of 
you can become Brian's light!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Because you all know it! You know very 
well that she needs someone to shine a 
light on her!!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Isn't that just super—marvelous☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mabe-chin...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, tell me about Brian too☆ What 
kind of girl is she? What can we do to 
make her MARVELOUS★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Fun things, favorite things, things you 
want! Mayano, Laurel, do you understand?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Brian-san is—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...I think she really loves running. Or 
rather... she loves racing."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. I love competing. It's my reason 
for living. I'm always starved for a 
heated battle... I crave it.”

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then that must be where Brian's 
Marvelous is☆ A blaaazing, sizzling, 
passionate showdown★☆★

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Right, Maya-chan?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't we give a present? To that 
struggling monster... something 
extraordinary enough to tear through those 
tangled chains."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: An exceptionally—heated showdown!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, and here I was about to say 
that! That's not fair, Laurel-san!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Eye copy! I'm gonna turn into someone who 
really fires you up!"

A light ignited in both of their eyes. It 
was like a flame piercing the darkness—or 
perhaps a hellfire that scorched the very 
soul.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mabe-chin, thanks for the joint training! 
Maya's gonna... push herself a bit solo 
this afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I won't lose either♪ ...See you later, 
Mave-chan!

"...Still, she's an amazing girl as 
always. As I watched her with that thought 
in mind—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—No matter who you're cheering for, 
there's always a cheer that can reach 
them, right? ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I won't change. I won't lose my way. I'll 
look forward!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Make the world marvelous. Make Fuji 
marvelous. ...And make Brian marvelous 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer☆

"Right, this is no time for mere 
admiration. I need to get myself fired up 
again. As Marvelous Sunday's Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
All right☆ Training! Training! Let's 
start, let's start★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! The morning was Marvelous with 
Mayano and the others, but... what should 
we do this afternoon? What are we doing!?
choice_data_list: Let's go for a run in the mountains!

Let's build up your stamina with some 
free-diving!

text_block_list.text:
During the camp, training is held mainly 
by the seaside. I thought heading into the 
mountains might be a nice change of pace, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho☆
choice_data_list: Hey, how far are we going...?
Hey, how far are we going—?

text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday charges forward endlessly 
along the mountain path—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You see, I've been hearing a voice calling 
out to me for a while now, saying, "Come 
over here!" ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ah, look! Trainer, over here!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer, you gotta see this too! 
Over here, there's a huge round clearing!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The trees and grass are all flattened—what 
happened here?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—I see, so it was you! Inside my head just 
now, there was... 〇%×#, ∂Ψ$*△&□—?!
choice_data_list: !! Marvelous, get back here right now!!!

text_block_list.text:
After returning to the training lodge, I 
heard an old local rumor passed down in 
this area. "If you enter the mountain, 
you'll be spirited away"—

I will never let them go near that area 
again! That was a scene where I firmly 
made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Roger that☆ Then count how long I can hold 
my breath underwater, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Here I goooo!!!

"...Still, no matter how long I waited, 
Marvelous Sunday did not return."
choice_data_list: Isn't it getting a bit late...?
Isn't it getting a bit late...?

text_block_list.text:
An hour has passed! This is bad, could 
they have been swept out to sea!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Why is it evening already?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Search Party
text_block_list.text:
Hey, she's over here! Isn't that her!? 
Hey, Trainer, we found her—!

After returning to the lodge and talking 
to her, it turned out that to Marvelous 
Sunday, it felt like she had only been 
under for a few minutes—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
When I went all the way to the ocean 
floor, I found some marvelous ruins down 
there☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
There was a stone house, and a huge 
temple! I got so excited and ran up to it, 
and then it suddenly started flashing 
super bright—!

Apparently, they woke up to find 
themselves on the beach. Whatever 
happened, I'm just glad they're safe!

The next day, when volunteers dove into 
the sea, they apparently found what looked 
like the desolate ruins of an ancient 
settlement. The surrounding area was 
thrown into an uproar for a time—
